purpose: Expand all 30 frozen Stage05F2A novelty-first strict rescue sequences across the complete frozen 919-genome source universe using annotation-independent six-frame maximal stop-to-stop peptides, then test whether any longer homolog preserves formal RVT-All profile support.
query_universe: all 30 Stage05F2A NOVELTY_FIRST_STRICT_RESCUE sequences; no outcome-based query removal
translation: six-frame maximal stop-to-stop; bacterial/archaeal code 11 stop set; no start-codon requirement; minimum 45 aa; full genomes, linear boundaries
core_homolog_rule: non-exact target AND evalue <= 1e-5 AND qcov >= 0.70 AND fident >= 0.25
broad_homolog_rule: non-exact target AND evalue <= 1e-3 AND qcov >= 0.50
major_extension_rule: longer target AND target_length >= max(180, 1.5 * query_length)
rvt_hmm_rule: full E <= 1e-4 AND best domain i-E <= 1e-4, using the frozen ~45-profile RVT-All collection
rvt_hmm_exploratory_rule: full E <= 1e-2 AND best domain i-E <= 1e-2; descriptive only
primary_endpoint: number of query-components with a non-exact longer whole-genome six-frame homolog outside the frozen Stage05F1 +/-10 kb neighborhood universe that also satisfies the frozen formal RVT-All rule
claim_boundary: Stage05F2E is a family/representation audit. Sequence homology, longer stop-to-stop peptides, HMM support, replication, or absence of a hit do not establish or exclude biochemical reverse-transcriptase activity or ART identity.
exact_recovery_invariant: direct AA SHA256 recovery from the materialized whole-genome six-frame instance registry; independent of MMseqs heuristic prefilter
mmseqs_exact_target_completeness: primary search with --mask 0; exhaustive fallback only for frozen queries whose directly verified exact target is absent from the primary returned-hit list
implementation_hotfix: v1.0.2 repairs the incomplete local codon table in F2E v1.0.0/v1.0.1 (62/64 codons; AAG and GAG omitted), strengthens the selftest to lock all 64 codons and the F1 translation-table SHA256, and forces regeneration of the 919-genome peptide universe. No query, source genome, homology threshold, HMM threshold, DNA score, rank, or candidate membership changes.
translation_table_lock: exact Stage05F1 64-codon translation dictionary; AAG->K; GAG->E
wholegenome_reuse_policy: v1.0.0/v1.0.1 materializations are forbidden because their local codon table omitted AAG and GAG; v1.0.2 rebuilds from frozen source FASTAs
